name: Machina II/The Friends & Enemies of Modern Music

podcast.body: Released in the fall of 2000, this record featured much of the remaining tracks from the *Glass and the Machines of God* project. It was notably given away for free online, a pioneering move at the time, and had an extremely limited physical release of only 25 copies, whose whereabouts are unknown. "In the fall of 2000, the Pumpkins released a record called Machina 2, the Friends and Enemies of Modern Music. It featured much of the rest of the tracks from glass and the Machines of God, and was given away for free online. Again, nobody was doing this kind of thing back then, so it was really cool."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album was released online, by which point many fans were already exhausted by the band's internal stories and dramas. "luego venía el machina dos que había salido por internet yo creo que ya mucha gente ya estaba como muy quemada de todas estas historias."
